card.title: Let Them Keep Hope
card.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

mechanism: A conceals the discouraging waiting-list position and offers increasing practical support to keep B gardening.
confusable: Unlike ordinary optimism, A must withhold specific discouraging information because giving up is explicitly threatened.
comparison: D111-b replaces A's bedroom with a growing space; D111-a redirects from rejection correspondence to a remaining gallery.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
